plugins.name: tdd-master
plugins.description: TDD plugin with Red-Green-Refactor workflow, testing patterns, and TDD-focused agent for Python/Django projects.

plugins.name: functional-clarity
plugins.description: Functional Clarity principles — philosophy for building reliable, simple, and understandable code. 22 principles, Python style guide, fail-fast architecture, Code-Change Discipline.

plugins.name: llms-keeper
plugins.description: Maintain llms.txt + llms-full.txt for any project following llmstxt.org standard. AI-optimized project context that works with any AI tool.

plugins.name: planner
plugins.description: File-backed feature pipeline with a product-discovery layer: /plan-idea (optional idea shaping), /plan-epic (shared hypothesis), /plan-roadmap (slice ordering) and /plan-feat, /plan-jira (slice requirements) write versioned product documents — an idea is not required to start. /plan then builds ready architecture and version-linked execution plans; /plan-do orchestrates implementation; /plan-reflect captures post-task lessons.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: SDLC pipeline plugin: 3 agents (architect, code-implementer, code-reviewer) covering design → implement → review across Python backend and React frontend. Stack-aware via on-demand references. References tdd-master and functional-clarity instead of duplicating.

plugins.name: clarity-language
plugins.description: Clarity of language: three skills against AI-synthetic text. clarity-validator (12 meaning-level antipatterns in technical docs, FPF-grounded), ai-prose-detector (fiction prose style across 6 methods), russian-style (natural Russian without calques, made-up Russian translations of established loanwords, empty antitheses, or bureaucratese).

plugins.name: fpf-integration
plugins.description: FPF ecosystem in one plugin: fpf-integration skill for adopting the First Principles Framework in multi-agent projects (reads the spec via the FPF reference MCP when connected, else a local copy — with no source it blocks and requires setup rather than degrading), dpf-authoring for authoring principle frameworks (6-phase pipeline with embedded role packages), dpf-apply for resolving and executing competency packages (ground/apply, freshness gate, worked-evidence journal), and end-session-setup for installing a session-closing ritual with a worked-evidence step. The dpf-gate agent guards work on a package: it checks admissibility, names the mode and returns a plan for confirmation — it holds no write tools, so it cannot edit packages.

plugins.name: fpf-competency-bank
plugins.description: Reference competency bank for FPF: distributable DPF/LPF packages (DPF-COUPLING-GENERALIZATION, LPF-SIMPLIFICATION-REVIEW) with an inherited critic verdict, resolved by fpf-integration's dpf-apply via ~/.claude/frameworks.paths.

plugins.name: plugin-testing
plugins.description: Behavioural testing for Claude Code plugins: author eval cases and graders, run the suite through a verifying wrapper, read a red run without weakening the gate, and keep per-plugin test reports.
